messages.subject: Aims and scope of this group
parts:
Welcome to the camtrapR user group!

This group is an offer to all users of camtrapR and everyone interested in using it.

It can be a place to discuss anything related to camtrapR, be it specific problems or bugs you encounter, the concepts and ideas the package applies, or general issues in camera trap data management.
We can that way hopefully improve the package and further increase its usefulness to you, the users.

Because this group is for you, please leave your comments and thoughts on how we can make the most out of this group, or be the first to post a new topic!

I sincerely hope that you will find this group useful.

Thanks for your interest in camtrapR!
Best regards,
Jürgen
